description: Which scoring-catalog behaviors feed each capability dimension, and how much. Separate from scoring.config.json on purpose: changing a weight here re-groups existing evidence, it never changes a competency score. Each behavior belongs to at most one dimension (no double counting). There is deliberately no overall score.

clinical.description: Use of evidence and relevance of claims, judged from what was said. Accuracy against approved product sources is not measured until a knowledge pack is linked.

adaptation.description: How well the rep adjusts to the physician's style and reactions.

discovery.description: Questioning, clarification, need discovery and objection exploration.

commitment.description: Moving toward an appropriate next action without forcing the close.
